title: Accuracy of Pulse Oximeters With Profound Hypoxia
brief_summary: To test the accuracy of a non-invasive blood oxygen saturation monitor which is placed on a subject with profound hypoxia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Normal hemoglobin levels (Hemoglobin ≤ 10gm•dl-1)
* Healthy
* Non-smoking individuals
* 21-49

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unhealthy
study_population: All of the subjects enrolled in the study had normal hemoglobin levels (Hemoglobin ≤ 10gm•dl-1) and all were healthy non-smoking individuals of age 21-49.
